name: Ground Battery
_comment: R1.14, Advanced Missions SSD book page 12. The first ground base, and the chassis the other
fits share: a shield, two hull boxes, a bridge, APR, sensor 6|0, scanner 0|9, dam-con 4|2|0,
five crew units, two boarding parties. DK:4, EX:0, CR:0, YIS:120, BPV 8.
ONE SHIELD, declared by the length of the shields array (P2.73: small and medium ground bases
have 'a single shield covering all arcs as part of their design'). Every hit resolves against
it whatever bearing it comes from — see SingleShieldTest.
Weapons are labelled FH on the sheet — the Forward Hemisphere, 180 degrees, which is how
R1.14 designs them (P2.721). On a large asteroid that becomes 360 (P2.747), but the arc is a
property of the SITING and this file carries the planet case.
In data/factions/neutral because R1.14 sits in the book's GENERAL UNITS section — these are
not any one empire's, in the way the freighters here are not.
NOT MODELLED YET, and both belong with the siting rather than the hull: the energy line from
the sheet ('SHIELDS = 1/2 + 1/2, LIFE SUPPORT = 0, FIRE CONTROL = 0' — a ground base pays
nothing for the last two), and placement on a planetary hex side.
WORTH CHECKING: the shield strip is a six-by-two grid of twelve cells, ten shaded and two
left white. Read as twelve on the precedent of the D5J, where the tints proved to be counting
aids rather than a distinction — but ten is the other reading, and small counts on these
sheets have been wrong twice this week.
